subject: Business management
notes: Maximum 1,800 words; only the first 1,800 are marked.
One real organisation, and exactly one of change, creativity, ethics or sustainability as the lens.
Three to five supporting documents must be attached.

25 marks across SEVEN criteria A-G, common to SL and HL under the 2024 guide. Both figures are corroborated: knowledge base 7.7 [OFFICIAL] and two independent sources give 25, and a published grader rubric plus a second source both reference a Criterion G. The earlier claim of four criteria totalling 20 marks is the outlier and is now ruled out.

The per-criterion SPLIT is still not publishable. The one source that lists all seven marks sums them to 27, not its own stated 25, and sources disagree on whether criterion A is the key concept or the context. Corroborated fragments only: key concept 5, supporting documents 4, presentation 2.
The official IB subject brief confirms the component (20 hours, 20% at HL) but carries no per-criterion marks, as subject briefs never do.
The public ibo.org subject page still describes the pre-2024 structure despite a 2026 'last updated' date — do not source from it.
